page.overview:
Who is Sherpa Sangye Dorje?

Sherpa Sangye Dorje is an Orient Expedition minifigure introduced in 2003. He is exclusive to the set 7417 Temple of Mount Everest.

The Sherpa has unprinted grey legs, and a dark orange torso decorated with a baggy shirt, a red sash, and a dagger. His arms are dark orange, and his hands are bright yellow. His face is bright yellow as well, and he has large eyes. He wears a large orange orange hat and an earth orange backpack.

Although consistently portrayed with grey legs in most LEGO media, an alternate printing of the 7417 Temple of Mount Everest building instructions' page 6 portrays him with dark grey legs instead, which are swapped with Ngan Pa. Both printings show him with the correct grey legs on page 45.

Sangye Dorje is a young Tibetan Sherpa who assists Johnny Thunder and his friends on Mount Everest during their quest for the Golden Sword.
